text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hehe~, how was it, Landlady? Our very own 
presentation of relaxing, chill-out time!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're always playing the host, aren't 
you? I just thought you might want to let 
your hair down for once~

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the hospitality was top-notch! They 
had sweets just the way I like 'em, tasty 
pickles, and even a stick-shaped body 
pillow that felt great.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
To think you prepared all this just for 
me... I'm truly grateful.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"...Still though. If you wear yourselves 
out trying to entertain your guests, it 
completely defeats the purpose, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Tran, didn't you stay up super late 
getting things ready? You've got dark 
circles under your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Acute, is that from... tending to 
theぬか床 (bran bed)? Your dominant arm 
looks swollen. Take it easy, or it'll 
affect your running.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Haha~. My research was flawless, though~ 
Guess my stealth skills still have a long 
way to go!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Since I had the chance, I pickled a 
huuuuge batch and picked the absolute best 
one. Though maybe I went a little 
overboard.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
See? You can't hide it from me whenever 
you push yourself even a little bit!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"...Come, over here. Allow me to 
thoroughly soothe those stiff muscles from 
all your hosting."
